$comment: Outbound webhook event catalog (docs/public-api.md). Every publishEvent(req, tx, '<type>', data) call in apps/api uses a type listed here (TypeScript enforces it) and every type listed here is published somewhere (`pnpm check:events`). Customers subscribe to these types; renaming or removing one, or changing the shape of its `data`, is a breaking change (versioning rule in docs/public-api.md). `data` names the OpenAPI schema of the payload's data field.

project.updated.description: A project's name or description changed.

project.deleted.description: A project and its attachments were deleted. `data` carries only its id.

project.summary_reviewed.description: A member confirmed or corrected the AI summary of a project (`aiStatus` tells which).
